ns2:section.sectionText: This course will meet on the following dates: July 7-9, 14-16, 20 & 21, 2015. 1:00-7:00 PM. Center for Innovation in Teaching & Learning (CITL) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.citl.illinois.edu. This course is part of a self-supporting program and DOES NOT accept the following tuition and fee waivers (TFWs): Cooperating Teacher waivers, Non-Academic waivers (including UIUC employees and employees of other state institutions), Academic waivers from UIUC, UIC and UIS employees, Related Agency waivers, Field Supervisor waivers, waivers granted through fellowships/assistantships as governed by the Graduate College at UIUC, or Retiree waivers. This program DOES accept statutory waivers (veterans grants, etc.).
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to CAS:Educ Org & Leadershp -UIUC, EDM:Educ Org & Leadershp -UIUC, CAS: Ed Pol Org & Ldrshp -UIUC, or EDM: Ed Pol Org & Ldrshp -UIUC.
